fields.label: Season
fields.description: What the trade calls it, e.g. Holi 2027. The document is named after it.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Whose season. Two companies on one site each run their own, and an order is only a booking inside its own company's season.

fields.label: Festival Date
fields.description: The day the season is for. Every other date here is read against it, and the balance due is stated relative to it.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Switched off, nothing books into it. A season is not deleted once it has orders against it.

fields.label: Booking Opens
fields.description: A primary order on or after this date, and on or before Booking Closes, is a booking of this season.

fields.label: Changes Allowed Until
fields.description: After this a booking may not be amended. Blank means Booking Closes. Stated separately because the trade usually allows changes for a little while after the book shuts.

fields.label: Delivery Starts
fields.description: A delivery date on a booking line must fall inside this window. Deliveries begin well after the book shuts, which is the whole point of booking a season.

fields.label: Season Price List
fields.description: What a booking is priced at. The rate is copied onto the line and locked when the booking is submitted, so a list corrected in January does not reprice an order taken in November.

fields.label: Advance Required
fields.description: Of the booking value, before it is released. Zero means none is required, which is a decision and not an oversight.

fields.label: Payment Terms Template
fields.description: ERPNext's own. It goes onto the Sales Order and ERPNext builds the payment schedule from it, so the balance due date is the one finance already maintains rather than a second copy here.
